description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fang], [Apex Highwind (XIII) Damage Tracker] and [Apex Highwind (XIII) Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fang
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Highwind (XIII) (0~2), removed after using Apex Highwind (XIII) two times

description.name: Apex Highwind (XIII) Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Highwind (XIII) level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fang]

description.name: Apex Highwind (XIII) Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Highwind (XIII) level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fang]

description.name: XIII
description.text: Twenty single ranged jump attacks (1.00/1.10/1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999/29999, followed by one single ranged jump attack (10.00/11.00/12.00) capped at 99999 at Apex Highwind (XIII) level 0/1/2, removes Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fang from the user
